items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1958-05-24
items.q: They all got together. Five of them. Johnny Hill, Bannister Brickley. Gene Brickley. And he still all with me.

ctx.x: Did he play much here in the city? Well, he liked you.

I did a good while. Then he got out for the boy. And Gene Brickley, we call him Black Baby. He had a brother named Bannister Brickley. They all got together. Five of them. Johnny Hill, Bannister Brickley. Gene Brickley. And he still all with me. He saw Lewis. And what all did they play?
